newsitem.title: USA: Colo. Comanche coal-fired unit outage extended.
newsitem.headline: Colo. Comanche coal-fired unit outage extended.

text.p: Work to repair fire damage at the Comanche coal-fired power plant's 350 megawatt (MW) unit 1 has been extended until January 20, a spokeswoman for Public Service Co of Colorado said Thursday.
The unit, located in Pueblo, Colo., was shut December 18 after a short cirucit in a cable tray caused the fire.
It was originally expected to be down for two or three weeks, but the outage was extended after damage was found to be more extensive, the spokeswoman said.
Comanche's 350 MW unit 2 was said to be operating normally.
PS Colorado is owner and operator of the Comanche plant.
